name: zzCH1_regress_wardrobe

tests.name: SWITCH SKIN was pressed, and the wardrobe opened from that press alone

detail.note: this is the founder's route. Every earlier proof used SetBrainSkinsOpen, which is not.

tests.name: the Project Brain is STILL OPEN with the wardrobe inside it

detail.note: the founder asked that the Brain not be replaced by the wardrobe

tests.name: the preview window has painted and reports where it is
the preview's pixels were readable for every skin, in every place looked at
no corner of the preview window is the blank white brain chamber, for any skin

detail.test: a corner fails only when it is BOTH bright (luma > 0.60) AND blank (fewer than 5% dark samples), which is what a wall is and what a mascot never is
detail.note: the Project Brain chamber the founder photographed is 0.97 white in every corner AND has nothing dark in it. Apollo's crown reaches two corners at 0.41 and 0.51 with 36% and 41% of those boxes still pure backdrop, which is a mascot standing in front of a black room.

tests.name: the middle of the window is lit and the corners are not -- a figure is standing there
the preview as a whole is a room with a mascot in it, not the blank white brain chamber

detail.test: the window fails only when it is BOTH bright (luma > 0.85) AND blank (fewer than 5% dark samples)
detail.note: the chamber fills the window edge to edge at 0.97 with nothing dark in it. Apollo at 0.754 is a mascot that fills its frame, which is what the founder asked for -- 75 to 85 per cent of usable preview height -- and not a fault.

tests.name: clicking each skin changes what the preview shows

detail.note: five skins, at least four distinguishable pictures

tests.name: pressing SWITCH SKIN again closes the wardrobe and leaves the Brain open
closing the Project Brain leaves nothing open behind it
